confidence.note: Most pricing and missed-call data come from vendor blogs; 20 clinic interviews and a real CAC test would raise it.

gross_margin.note: ~49% margin (estimate): $101 voice, PMS API, fees on $199. R5 cap: costs_eat_margin hit (2.5 -> 2).

pricing_power.note: $199 undercuts $299-$899 dental tools; generic Quo Sona tops out at $199. Price is the only lever.

build_effort.note: Voice API + Open Dental slot/booking API: ~4-6 weeks at 10 h/week; HIPAA setup on top.

skills_match.note: Developer covers the build; dental workflows, HIPAA and B2B sales are new.

capital_needed.note: $2,000 covers a pilot on Open Dental; Dentrix write access costs $10,000 one-time.

time_to_mvp.note: First paid pilot ~8 weeks out (estimate): build, BAA, per-practice PMS access.

sales_cycle.note: Dentist demo, trust in an AI touching the schedule, PMS vendor access: weeks per deal.

channel_readiness.note: No audience; cold outreach only. Dental clicks average $7.85; ADA channel taken by Weave.

trend.note: +86% YoY search growth for 'AI receptionist' (DataForSEO via FindSkill, 2026).

free_alternatives.note: Quo includes 10 free AI calls/month; Weave bundles it. Free covers part, not PMS booking.

competitor_density.note: 20+ direct competitors found: Weave, Arini, Flossy, Dentina, Viva, TensorLinks, SmileDial...

differentiation.note: Only a lower price. 'I am a developer' is not an edge buyers see.

legal_regulatory.note: PHI on calls: BAAs needed across telephony, LLM, TTS and storage; TCPA for AI-voice callbacks.

platform_dependency.note: Depends on PMS API access per practice and on one voice-AI vendor's pricing.

market_risk.note: Durable need: 55% of dentists find admin hiring extremely/very hard (ADA HPI, 2025).

skills.note: Builds software; no dental, healthcare compliance or sales track record stated.

assets.note: No audience, dental network or data stated.

interest.note: Goal stated as side income; no domain interest stated.

tam.reasoning: 138,982 US dental office locations (BLS via StartBusinessByState, Q1 2026) x $199 x 12. IBISWorld counts 180,742 businesses, so this is the low end.

sam.reasoning: No source for the share of practices on open-API PMS without an AI phone tool.

som.reasoning: 15 clinics x $199 x 12. Capacity: 10 h/week, ~30 h per closed sale -> ~1.3 sales/month max.

price.reasoning: User's stated price: $199/month; no market test yet.

variable_cost_per_unit.reasoning: 500 min x $0.11/min voice AI ($55, Retell components) + Open Dental API $35 + Stripe 2.9%+$0.30 ($6) + number/SMS $5 = $101.

churn_monthly_pct.reasoning: SMB SaaS benchmarks 3-7%/month; 6.2% in 2026 (Visionary Marketing). 5% used.

conversion_rate_pct.reasoning: 1 paid clinic per 50 cold contacts (calls, emails, walk-ins); no channel benchmark found.

cac.reasoning: 30 founder hours per closed clinic (outreach, demo, PMS setup) x $50/hour.

time_to_first_revenue_weeks.reasoning: 4-6 weeks build at 10 h/week + 2 weeks pilot sale and PMS access approval.

launch_reason: The user chose the US; it is also the largest dental market with open PMS APIs (Open Dental).

rules_applied.effect: Profit potential 1.83 (2 or less): 51 - 10 = 41, capped at 49 -> 41 (was 51)

cheapest_test: Call 40 local dental offices at lunch and after 5 pm to measure voicemail rate, then pitch 20 dental marketing agencies a white-label pilot; stop below 2 paid pilots by day 7.
kill_criteria: Fewer than 10 of 40 test calls reach voicemail by day 1 -> the missed-call pain is too small, stop
Fewer than 3 discovery calls from 20 agency emails by day 5 -> drop the agency path
Fewer than 2 paid pilots or signed LOIs at $199+/month by day 7 -> archive it

rescue.change: Sell a white-label Open Dental voice connector to dental marketing agencies, who resell it to their clinics.
rescue.why: Fixes no_distribution and channel_readiness: agencies already own the dentist relationship; lowers CAC.
rescue.requires: 2-3 dental marketing agencies willing to pilot; a HIPAA-ready stack

rescue.change: Done-for-you service: set up and tune an AI receptionist for Open Dental practices, $500 setup + $299/month.
rescue.why: Raises pricing_power and ltv_cac; service work beats 20+ products on trust, not features.
rescue.requires: Local in-person sales to practices; time beyond 10 h/week to support clinics
